summary: This sermon launches a new series at a church merger, using Acts 2:41-47 to cast vision for a healthy, unified church. Ryan identifies four core attitudes that should characterize both individual believers and the congregation: commitment to Christ-centered doctrine, devotion to prayer, submission to the Holy Spirit, and investment in authentic biblical community.
key_points: Committed to core doctrine that keeps Jesus at the center, prioritizing relationships over secondary theology
Devoted to prayer both individually and corporately as the fuel for church health
Submitted to the Holy Spirit in both its curious supernatural aspects and common unifying work
Invested in authentic biblical community that is both effortful and vulnerable, not shallow or surface-level
big_idea: A healthy and effective church is built on individuals who are committed to Jesus-centered doctrine, devoted to prayer, submitted to the Holy Spirit, and invested in authentic biblical community.
title: Imagine a Church
